title: Free Human Theme Kit: take in the design system and load the theme into Frequency (website, Spotlight, Space page, email, starter kits)
detail: The Free Human Movement design system (code id free-human, editor theme FreeHuman) goes through docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM-INTAKE.md: rules, inventory, tokens, copy and a baseline of known gaps that only shrinks. The kit is then built the way Temple was: foundation and tokens, assets, chrome, eleven blocks, Home and Calendar pages, four emails, Spotlight layouts, thirteen starter kits and a /themes page on the Nocturne layout. Owner ruling 2026-10-29: load the theme only. No Free Human Movement Space or site data is created or seeded. Photo rights in design/photos/README.md are unresolved: the copyrighted ones must not ship in anything a Space receives until cleared.

verify.evidence: The design-system baseline for free-human is empty and the theme is registered in the Space picker.
